inspected_anchors.finding: Python graph validator accepts declared graph classes or dict and returns variables unchanged;PlanarLayout forces DEFAULT mode with warning.
inspected_anchors.limit: Selected validator does not establish complete graph-class or causal validation.

inspected_anchors.finding: Frontend update sets graph variable then calls on_update without awaiting it.
inspected_anchors.limit: No backend scientific approval or persistent transaction guarantee inferred.

inspected_anchors.finding: Default-mode add/reverse paths invoke cycle checks;reverse branch drops selected edge then passes original selected tuple to willCreateCycle.
inspected_anchors.limit: Static tuple trace;native reachability/backend graph behavior not executed.

inspected_anchors.finding: Accept sets rendering_properties.accepted;new edge type depends on editor mode.
inspected_anchors.limit: Rendering acceptance is not scientific evidence or identification.

inspected_anchors.finding: Edge serializer swaps endpoints for backwards directed edge;outer serializer swaps embedded endpoints again while storing under reversed keys.
inspected_anchors.limit: Symbolic selected-path mismatch witness;reachable native failure not established.

inspected_anchors.finding: Update callback is trailing-debounced150ms and subscribed to graph events.
inspected_anchors.limit: A coalesced callback is not an authenticated per-edit evidence ledger.

inspected_anchors.finding: Components/core/create-dara-app declare1.29.11 and Python>=3.10,<3.13;component delegate cai-causal-graph>=0.3.6.
inspected_anchors.limit: Declared dependency floor is not a resolved lock or native compatibility result.

inspected_anchors.finding: Root and graph-editor Apache2.0 notices retained.
inspected_anchors.limit: No blanket clearance for transitive dependencies,commercial offerings,models,data or services. no commercial entitlement inferred.
